notes.title: We’ve upgraded the demo!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/bd6f3948e3a8df71c0e7d1bb21d8f67f168c8944.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/881d79606909d8de99f1622e191a352d1cf65634.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/6a6c59d6c500ed2ffcc55fc7c49c24b3c976e1af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/382098e99bf14ca2d6985580486fe72e05a25756.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/dcc03e17e697dc555b3e97c8d8102d0bc251f0b4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/830450175bfa5fe12d879768c64a9dcdfcb1b8b6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/52a0ec81572c9eb04a5f505cacb859502c047d7e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/9dc26aff749d9f5c22f73585520cdc92e53c6282.png[/img][/url]

We’ve upgraded the demo! Feel free to give it a try!  
We’re now diving into full scenario implementation, so please look forward to the official release!

[h2]Changes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Updated visuals!  
[*] Slightly expanded opening scene!  
[*] The feel of pressing the high-voltage switch has changed! (You’ll have to play to see how!)  
[/list]

Currently, we are only offering the Japanese version, but we plan to provide an English version in the future. Please stay tuned!
